description: One shared (common-area) cost pool of a property, split across its units and billed to tenants as a service charge (CAM) through the existing Charge Engine.

fields.description: Whole-property amount PER PERIOD (ex-VAT) to split across units.
fields.label: Pool / Period

fields.description: How each unit's share is weighted. Area = by area_sqm; Equal = one share each; Custom Weight = unit.cam_weight; Rent Share = unit's active-lease annual rent.
fields.label: Allocation Basis
fields.options:
Area
Equal
Custom Weight
Rent Share

fields.description: Blank = inherit the company default (Real Estate Settings → Default CAM Vacant Policy). Owner Absorbs = a vacant unit's slice stays with the owner (tenants pay only their own fair share). Redistribute = the whole pool is split across occupied units.
fields.label: Vacant Unit Policy

fields.description: The single anchor for the billing schedule (defaults to today — CAM never back-bills).
fields.label: Start Date

fields.description: Optional income account override (recommend a dedicated CAM / Service Charge Income account). Else the Charge Type's Service Item income account. MUST NOT be a rent income account.
fields.label: Revenue Account

fields.description: Optional VAT template override; else resolved from each tenant lease's contract type (commercial 15% / residential exempt).
fields.label: Tax Template

name: Property Service Charge
